newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Grenade caused blast at Czech hospital - CTK.
newsitem.headline: Grenade caused blast at Czech hospital - CTK.

text.p: An explosion that killed two people and seriously injured another at a hospital in the northeast Czech city of Ostrava was caused by a hand grenade, the CTK news agency reported on Wednesday.
CTK quoted Ostrava police officials as saying the blast on Tuesday was caused by a powerful "defensive hand grenade", used by soldiers defending their positions in trench warfare.

Police did not say who was responsible for the blast which killed two cleaning women and seriously injured a third working in the dermatology unit of the Ostrava-Fifejdach hospital in Northern Moravia.
Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus told reporters on Tuesday he could not rule out terrorism and he would insist on the "deepest and fastest investigation of all circumstances" surrounding the blast.
